clue.text: There's no charge for the present

definitions.text: There's no charge for the present

parts.words: There's no charge for the present
parts.note: a present here is something given, and one given with nothing to pay costs the recipient nothing

explanation.surface: A shop announces that, for now, there is no fee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For the present' reads as 'for now', but the present is a gift.
explanation.definitionFit: A present you are not charged for is a complimentary offering.

clue.text: A producer at one time

definitions.meaning: one who forms or makes something
earlier, previous, belonging to the past

explanation.definitionFit: One who forms things is a maker; and the adjective describes something past or earlier.

clue.text: With apparent hesitation store valuable fur

parts.note: ER is the sound of a speaker hesitating
a mine is a rich store or source of something

explanation.surface: A hesitant buyer stocks up on an expensive pelt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'With apparent' only joins: the hesitation shows in the spoken ER.
explanation.definitionFit: The white winter coat of the stoat is a prized fur, once worn by royalty and judges.

clue.text: A person may well look into it and reflect

definitions.text: A person may well look into it and reflect

parts.words: A person may well look into it and reflect
parts.note: reads as someone pondering a matter, but describes peering into a mirror and seeing a reflection

explanation.surface: Someone investigates a matter and thinks it over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reflect' looks like 'ponder', but a mirror reflects your image back.
explanation.definitionFit: A looking-glass is a mirror, which you look into to see your reflection.

clue.text: Under the impression some emotion is called for

definitions.meaning: believing or sensing something to be so, as in having a hunch

explanation.surface: A belief that some sentiment is needed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is called for' only joins the two meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a hunch that something is true is a sense of it; and a sentiment such as love or anger is an emotion.

clue.text: About to go into action so double up

indicators.note: the word for about is placed inside the word for action

parts.note: a case is a legal action brought in court
RE is a standard word for about or concerning

explanation.surface: Someone is about to act and so doubles over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About to' looks like 'on the point of', but 'About' is the abbreviation and 'to go into' signals the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: To fold something over on itself leaves a fold line in it.

clue.text: Production of non-crease material resulting in boom

indicators.note: the letters of the word are produced in a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A factory makes crease-resistant cloth and business booms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Production of' rearranges the letters of NON-CREASE; 'material resulting in' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep reverberating sound such as a boom is sonorous ringing or echoing.

clue.text: Subversive article about framing a rich eccentric

indicators.note: the article and the abbreviation surround the other letters

parts.note: AN is the indefinite article
C is short for circa, about

indicators.note: an eccentric arrangement of the letters

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece about a rich oddball is deemed subversive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eccentric' rearranges the letters of 'a rich' into ARCHI; 'framing' has the article and abbreviation sit either side of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Subversive behaviour defies order and authority, like lawlessness.

clue.text: This is bound to have an inflationary effect!

definitions.text: This is bound to have an inflationary effect!

parts.words: This is bound to have an inflationary effect!
parts.note: reads like economics, but describes a device for making photographs bigger

explanation.surface: A warning that some policy will drive up prices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Inflationary' suggests rising prices; here it means making images larger.
explanation.definitionFit: A darkroom device projects a negative to make bigger prints, so it magnifies.

clue.text: Storms and raves about a representative

indicators.note: the word for raves goes round the other letters

parts.note: to rave is to rage wildly
an MP is a Member of Parliament, an elected representative

explanation.surface: An angry crowd storms and shouts about their MP.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' signals the container; 'and' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: To charge about violently is to go on a wild spree.

clue.text: Attack a dolt and suffer for it

parts.note: an ass is a fool or dolt
to ail is to suffer or be unwell

explanation.surface: Someone hits an idiot and pays the price for it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for it' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: To assault someone violently is to set upon them.

clue.text: Suitable pay

definitions.meaning: fitting or proper, an old-fashioned sense
to settle a bill or cost

explanation.definitionFit: The archaic adjective means fitting or proper; and the verb means settle, as in covering expenses.

clue.text: She could well be responsible for internees

indicators.note: the letters of the word could produce something else when rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A woman who might be in charge of prisoners in a camp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Could well be responsible for' rearranges INTERNEES into a woman's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's first name, so a female person could be called this.

clue.text: Better way to freeze, right?

parts.note: N, north, is a compass direction, a way to go
to ice is to freeze

explanation.surface: Asking whether some method of freezing is an improvement.
explanation.walkthrough: The way here is a compass point, N for north.
explanation.definitionFit: More pleasant or agreeable is an improvement, so it compares as superior.

clue.text: Some people like grilling such fish

indicators.note: some of the word, a run of letters inside it, is the answer

explanation.surface: Many people enjoy this fish cooked under the grill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' signals letters taken from inside GRILLING.
explanation.definitionFit: A long slender food fish of the cod family found in northern seas.

clue.text: Reluctantly enlisted and cut quite a dash

definitions.meaning: forced into military or naval service, as by the old press gangs
made a strong favourable impact on others

explanation.definitionFit: Men seized by press gangs were forced into service; and someone who made a fine show won admiration.

clue.text: New form of steel in use — can be stretched

indicators.note: the letters are given a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A new type of steel in service is flexible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New form of' rearranges STEEL IN; 'use' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: A material capable of being drawn out or extended under tension is ductile.

clue.text: Invite trouble since appearing in a satire

indicators.note: the word for since goes inside the word for satire

parts.note: a skit is a short satirical sketch
for can mean since or because

explanation.surface: Someone courts trouble by featuring in a satirical piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Appearing in' signals the insertion; FOR meaning since is a common crossword equivalence.
explanation.definitionFit: To behave in a way that provokes a bad outcome is to court disaster.

clue.text: Do away with service area

parts.note: Mass is the Catholic service of the Eucharist
an acre is a unit of land area

explanation.surface: A demand to abolish a motorway service area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Service area' looks like a motorway rest stop but splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To slaughter people in large numbers is to kill them off.

clue.text: Testy camera-operator?

parts.note: a bad-tempered person bites back sharply, and a photographer clicks the shutter; both are described by one word

explanation.surface: An irritable photographer.
explanation.walkthrough: One who snaps is both irritable and a photographer.
explanation.definitionFit: A photographer takes snaps, and an irritable person speaks sharply; one noun covers both.

clue.text: Sit at leisure in a bar, estaminet, or bistro

indicators.note: the answer lies inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Relaxing in a pub, café or bistro.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'bar, estaminet'; an estaminet is a small French café. 'or bistro' only completes the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: To relax and stay idle is to take a break.

clue.text: Blood-sucker a large number support

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for 100, a large number
a leg supports a table or chair

explanation.surface: A vampire backed by a large crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: A cleg is a horsefly, which bites to suck blood.
explanation.definitionFit: The horsefly, whose female bites livestock and people to feed on blood.

clue.text: Combine caught over a seemingly sure thing

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
on can mean over, as in on top of
a cert is a certainty, a sure thing

explanation.surface: A conglomerate snapped up a business that seemed a safe bet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a seemingly' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: To act together in harmony is to work as one, so it means unite.

clue.text: Key of gold on a ring

parts.note: C is a musical key
or is gold in heraldry
taken as written

explanation.surface: A golden key on a key ring.
explanation.walkthrough: In heraldry OR means gold.
explanation.definitionFit: A halo of light round the sun or moon is a luminous circle.

clue.text: Coming changes to end VAT

indicators.note: the letters are changed into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Plans to abolish value added tax are on the way.
explanation.walkthrough: VAT is the UK's value added tax; 'changes to' rearranges END VAT.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrival is an appearance or approach, the season before Christmas included.

clue.text: Charge all round America to find a firing device

indicators.note: the word for charge surrounds the abbreviation

parts.note: a fee is a charge for a service
US is short for United States, America

explanation.surface: Searching across America for a gun trigger after paying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'All round' signals the container. A fusee is an old word for a fuse for setting off explosives.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for a fuse, used to ignite an explosive charge.

clue.text: A certain coolness drags on if improperly dealt with

indicators.note: handled badly, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Relations cool when a matter drags on because of poor handling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Improperly dealt with' rearranges DRAGS ON IF.
explanation.definitionFit: Composure under pressure is a calm, unruffled kind of coolness.

clue.text: Overweight — a pound put on could be disastrous!

parts.note: fat means overweight
L is the abbreviation for pound, from libra

explanation.surface: Gaining another pound when already overweight might be ruinous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put on' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: Something deadly or ruinous causes death or catastrophe.

clue.text: Set back one's vacation?

definitions.meaning: placed further in, as a niche in a wall
a break, as when Parliament or a court stops sitting

explanation.definitionFit: To place in an alcove is to set it back in a wall; and a parliamentary break is a holiday period.

clue.text: Temporary housing hold-up

parts.note: reads as a delay to temporary homes, but means something that holds up a canvas shelter

explanation.surface: A delay in providing temporary homes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hold-up' looks like a delay but is a support.
explanation.definitionFit: The support that keeps a camping shelter upright.

clue.text: A crack about the aim to be in vogue

indicators.note: the word for a crack goes round the word for aim

parts.note: to have a crack is to have a try
an end is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: Someone attempts to become fashionable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' signals the container; 'the' and 'to be' only join.
explanation.definitionFit: Fashionable and up to date, following the latest fashions.

clue.text: Resolute to begin without law-breaking

indicators.note: outside, so the word for begin surrounds the other letters

parts.note: to start is to begin

indicators.note: the word law is broken up and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone determined to start a life without breaking the law.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Breaking' rearranges the word law into ALW, and 'without', in its old sense of outside, signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Loyal, steadfast and determined, as a dependable supporter is.
